subject.title: fix(heartbeat): suppress Conversation info block for synthetic heartbeat turns

question: Which heartbeat metadata suppression path should be canonical for the open heartbeat prompt bug?
rationale: Two external PRs target the same root cause, current main has moved the prompt metadata code, and the safer owner boundary is a maintainer choice before either conflicting branch is repaired or merged.

options.title: Use caller-owned suppression
options.body: Prefer a rebased `get-reply-run.ts` fix that uses `opts.isHeartbeat` to skip synthetic inbound user context and require redacted real heartbeat proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt helper-level suppression
options.body: Keep this branch's generic metadata-helper approach only if maintainers intentionally want provider-string ownership there and the branch is rebased without losing newer metadata fields.

options.title: Close after another candidate lands
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97072 or a replacement lands first, close this duplicate candidate with credit and a link to the shipped fix.

recommendation.title: Use caller-owned suppression
recommendation.body: Prefer a rebased `get-reply-run.ts` fix that uses `opts.isHeartbeat` to skip synthetic inbound user context and require redacted real heartbeat proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent auto-reply prompt metadata history makes this the best available routing owner for the caller-boundary versus metadata-helper decision.
